fusions.name: Hooding Toss
fusions.desc: Throws a weighted cloth over the target's head for 8 damage, stunning it for 1.5 seconds.

fusions.name: Twisted Sash Choke
fusions.desc: Usable only on a target at or below 25% health. You choke it with a twisted sash for 22 damage, using up every affliction on it and adding their remaining damage to the blow.

fusions.name: Woven Nest
fusions.desc: Weaves a nest where you stand. For 8 seconds it restores 3 health a second to you and every ally inside it, within 3 tiles.

fusions.name: Layered Wraps
fusions.desc: Every time you use an ability, a stack builds on you, up to 10. At 10 they all spend at once: you gain a shield that soaks 6% of your maximum health per stack (56% at full). Unfed, a stack fades every 6 seconds.
